description: This file defines the LoanRepayment class and related functions for managing loan repayment processes, including validation, accounting entries, interest accruals, penalties, and related calculations within a loan management system.

classes.name: LoanRepayment
classes.description: Class handling loan repayment operations, including validation, accounting, interest accrual, and shortfall management.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the loan repayment data before processing.

methods.name: before_submit
methods.description: Pre-submit hook to book unaccrued interest.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions upon submission, such as updating paid amounts and creating accounting entries.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions upon cancellation, including marking as unpaid and reversing entries.

methods.name: set_missing_values
methods.description: Sets default or missing values for the repayment record.

methods.name: check_future_entries
methods.description: Checks for existing future repayment entries to prevent overlaps.

methods.name: validate_amount
methods.description: Ensures the paid amount is not zero.

methods.name: book_unaccrued_interest
methods.description: Books interest paid in excess of interest payable as unaccrued interest.

methods.name: update_paid_amount
methods.description: Updates the paid principal and interest amounts in related records.

methods.name: mark_as_unpaid
methods.description: Reverses the effects of a repayment, marking it as unpaid.

methods.name: allocate_amounts
methods.description: Allocates the paid amount into principal, interest, and penalties.

methods.name: make_gl_entries
methods.description: Creates general ledger entries for the repayment transaction.
